sources: Bonekrusha (3 pieces): rmxlinux Json/SkillData/passive_equipsuit_attrisuit_01 (game 1.6): ATK +atk_up (stat panel) and BuffData buff_equipsuit_attrisuit_01: on the wearer's cast (abilityEvent 30) of a combo skill (CheckSkillType [6]) a layer of buff_equipsuit_attrisuitup_01 (stackingType 2, max max_stack 2). attrisuitup_01 on the wearer's battle-skill cast (CheckSkillType [2]) saves its layer count, creates buff_equipsuit_attrisuitup_02 (DamageScaleProcessor NormalCalcZone +dmg_up × layers on hits of mask 256 of that cast only: CheckSkillCastId) and ends all its layers.
